subject.title: fix(edit): show candidate lines with similarity scores on oldText match failure

question: Which edit mismatch diagnostic implementation and output shape should be canonical for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/97032?
rationale: Multiple open PRs solve the same user problem with different diagnostic richness and safety fixes; automation cannot safely choose the permanent user-facing error format or which contributor branch maintainers want to sponsor.

options.title: Consolidate On One Bounded Implementation
options.body: Choose a single branch with incremental bounded collection and richer whitespace/escape diagnostics, then close or rebase the other candidates after that lands.

options.title: Repair This Narrow Branch
options.body: Keep this PR as the candidate only after replacing the full-file split with bounded collection and rebasing it onto current edit.ts behavior.

options.title: Land Concise Hints First
options.body: Accept candidate-line similarity hints as a narrower first increment and track side-by-side diff, escape, and indentation markers separately.

recommendation.title: Consolidate On One Bounded Implementation
recommendation.body: Choose a single branch with incremental bounded collection and richer whitespace/escape diagnostics, then close or rebase the other candidates after that lands.
